title: The Receptivity Gate: Permission Check
subtitle: The second position in the chain, a gate between seeing and naming.
key_concept: A permission check that must be passed before naming what is seen, ensuring receptivity.
visual_metaphor: A heavy stone gate with amber-lit runes, set in a dark cathedral corridor, with a figure pausing before it.
highlights: Permission check between seeing and naming
why_it_matters: Establishes a new structural element in the process, defining a critical transition point.
zone_change: New gate node added to the Process zone, between Observation and Intervention.
